name: Mac Window

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Product already ships ManagedWindow + WindowChrome with macOS traffic lights on Electron
Attached modal sheets and centered dialogs

representativeVariants.whySelected: The flagship container: 28px glass window with macOS controls
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: traffic lights (12px, #ff5f57/#febc2e/#28c840), centered or leading document title, trailing toolbar icons; body below hairline

representativeVariants.whySelected: Background windows must recede without disappearing
macOS sheet modality: dialog attached to parent window, slides from title bar
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: headline, form content, right-aligned cancel/default buttons

representativeVariants.whySelected: Inspector / right-side panel with compact title bar and segmented tabs
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: panel title, tab segment, close affordance

anatomy: traffic light cluster (close/minimize/zoom, 8px gap, hover glyphs)
structurePatterns: Traffic lights 12px diameter, 8px gap, 14-16px inset; glyphs appear on hover only
Title is 13px semibold, 12px tracking, muted when inactive
Window appears with scaleIn 0.96→1 + fade 200ms; sheets slide-down 250ms emphasized

usageHints.do: Keep traffic light colors exact; center title in key window for document feel
usageHints.avoid: Do not draw custom title bars that ignore the drag region or system double-click-to-zoom

unknowns: Fullscreen traffic-light hide animation handled by Electron shell
keyInsightSeed: A Mac window is glass with three honest pixels: red, yellow, green — everything else stays quiet.
